background:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original environment background plate for a 1920x1080 animated streamer outro lobby. Wide 16:9 landscape. A lavishly detailed, whimsical 3D-rendered midnight disco clubhouse inside an enchanted woodland conservatory, warm lived-in absurdist miniature set, film-quality physically based materials and playful chunky geometry. Front-facing wide lens, symmetrical central perspective with subtle asymmetric props. Rich electric turquoise, violet, pink, cobalt and amber lighting, dark enough that separately animated neon props will read beautifully.

Layout is essential: entire room visible edge to edge, back wall in upper half; a LARGE EMPTY dark widescreen recessed video screen centered on back wall, extending approximately x=30% to 70%, y=17% to 45%, with a metallic neon-trimmed surround. Do NOT paint any content or lettering on screen. Curved stage at y=65%; broad unobstructed glossy checker tiled dance floor extending over bottom 35% toward camera. Keep the center foreground and both front corners free of characters and large furniture, because separate animated mascots and DJ booth will be composited there. In the side walls, enchanted forest outside arched glass windows, glowing mushrooms, carved ram horn, bear paw, turtle-shell and firebird motifs as architectural accents. Side upper shelves hold pleasantly weird little objects: a crescent moon lamp, glass fruit, a ceramic duck, tiny rocket, leafy plants, a hovering-looking crystal on a stand. Hanging greenery, draped string lights, stage arches, exposed copper pipes, patches of holographic material. Two blank sign plaques on side walls for later editable typography. Floor reflects the color of the room.

The feeling is a bizarre cozy nightclub where forest spirits throw an afterparty: playful, colorful, slightly surreal, beautifully tactile, engaging to explore. Not an illustration poster, not corporate futuristic UI, not scary. No people or animals, NO text, NO logos, NO baked-in disco balls, NO speaker cabinets, NO laser beams (all will be added and animated separately). No centered title, no border outside the room. Supply high-resolution clean full-bleed environment artwork.
storage: Only room and booth generations retained. All four mistaken animal generations, runtime copies and prior previews were deleted by user request.
booth: Use case: stylized-concept. A single isolated DJ booth prop on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, horizontal wide composition. Premium fantasy-film 3D physically based render, front-facing near-orthographic camera at modest height so the top surface is visible. An eccentric enchanted-forest nightclub DJ console, wide rounded curved cabinet in dark polished ebony with worn brass edging, translucent jade crystalline side panels, small moss and vine accents. The cabinet front is a LARGE clean plain dark inset rectangular display panel occupying the middle 70%, no text, no graphics, no logos, because animated typography will be drawn there later. Above the cabinet a sloped tabletop contains two detailed black turntables with turquoise and violet illuminated rings, center mixer with little sliders, colorful square pads, tiny meter strips. Rich tactile materials, soft neon turquoise, violet and amber edge lights, polished but pleasantly lived-in. TWO short solid little brass feet visible, no characters, no headphones, no cables outside the prop, no speakers, no background, no cast shadow. Entire full booth visible with 6% clear transparent margin. Shape roughly 3.5 times as wide as tall. It will be composited at center of an animated room.
spirits: Approved gritty animal artwork remains preserved in its own features and is not loaded by this lobby.
penguin: Classic frames at 2x previous width, upright/front-facing, whole-character 68% translucency. Opposite wave slots, eased pose transitions and periodic recoloring make the 3.8-second ten-emote loop seamless.

cleanup.request_summary: Conservative detail cleanup of the original plates, not a redesign. Preserve the exact composition, viewpoint, layout, prop placement, room palette, architectural motifs, empty screen/sign bounds and booth silhouette. Resolve smeared foliage, materials, controls and edges into crisp coherent detail; localize bloom. Add no characters, text or new props. Preserve booth transparency.

room.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied original nightclub background plate. This is a conservative cleanup and definition pass, NOT a redesign. Preserve the exact original 16:9 composition, camera angle, architecture, woodland conservatory setting, placement and geometry of EVERY existing object, colors, warm brass and jade materials, cyan/violet/amber lighting, lush greenery, checkered reflective floor, couches, windows, duck and shelf props, architectural animal reliefs, central moon emblem, blank side signs, and the completely blank black central screen. Preserve the central screen's exact bounds and the floor perspective so existing animated overlays still align. Improve clarity: finely defined brass edges, coherent window mullions, clean floor tile seams, precise shelves and discrete leaves, remove smeared/mushy texture and indistinct doubled edges. Use restrained crisp physically rendered detail, localized light bloom only. Keep the original charming rich room intact. Do not flatten into vector geometry. Do not change room layout, enlarge or move any screen, add or remove objects, add characters, text, speakers, disco balls or beams. Return the full original room at high resolution with sharper well-resolved details.
